execution_policy: One exclusive run-claim.json next to protocol; no resume or retry

plan.denominators: Every trace-level metric reports true/false/unavailable among all 503 retained traces; also show success/504 planned slots without scoring the failed slot as disagreement. Receipt-level counts report their own observed receipt denominator. Equal null states or unassessable alignments are agreement only, not known-state coverage.
plan.design: post-hoc offline migration conformance; retained factual single-action traces
plan.development_disclosure: Runner development may use four existing tests/fixtures/v0.1 migration examples and synthetic mutation/error fixtures, including an isolated frozen-1.1 integration check. These are development checks, excluded from the 503-trace measured corpus.
plan.diagnosis_policy: Compare exact ordered codes secondarily, retain all additions/removals; no normalization. 2.0 may add UNASSESSABLE_ASSESSMENT for known refund outcomes with unknown/partial reports or unsupported target linkage. Display labels/messages/graphs are not invariants.
plan.failures: retain every failure/unavailable value; no retries, replacements, or exclusions
plan.inference: descriptive paired conformance counts only; no p-values or population generalization
plan.latest_rule: last recorded receipt/assessment for the action, preserving recorded order
limitations: 0.1 never recorded its clock origin: migrate to relative_ms, not an inferred epoch
one recorded action becomes a one-item list; no general multi-action validation
migration preserves recorded conclusions by construction; fresh verification is separate
target matches/findings are rederived metadata, absent from the legacy receipt
only the retained refund predicate is measured; custom verifier fixtures are development only
historical policies, labels, gold, analysis, and collection provenance remain unchanged
plan.receipt_observation_binding: exactly one evidence item; join by observation_id; no fallback

current.metadata_policy: Imported pinned source defines behavior; ambient metadata is disclosed

legacy.metadata_policy: Imported pinned source defines behavior; ambient metadata is disclosed
